title: Check if the discrete GPU is powered off
summary: Check the power state of the discrete GPU to see if it is suspended (off) or running. This helps verify if power management is working correctly to save battery.

steps.explain: Check the power state of all DRM cards. Look for 'suspended' (off) or 'running' (on).
steps.expect: Output like 'D3hot' or 'D0' for each card. D3hot/D3cold usually means off/suspended.

steps.explain: For NVIDIA GPUs specifically, check the runtime status. Replace <PCI_ADDRESS> with the PCI address of your NVIDIA GPU (e.g., 0000:01:00.0).

placeholders.name: PCI_ADDRESS
placeholders.description: The PCI address of the NVIDIA GPU

steps.expect: 'suspended' means the GPU is off. 'active' or 'running' means it is on.
